input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream} 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace && ls -la /workspace/.github 2>/dev/null; find /workspace -name 'PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE*' -o -name '*PR_TEMPLATE*' 2>/dev/null | head

git remote -v && git branch -a && git log --all --oneline -20 && git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/scratch 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/.git/HEAD; git show-ref
node smoke.ts; echo "smoke_exit:$?"; node scratch/check.ts; echo "check_exit:$?"

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts /workspace/scratch && node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1 && node smoke.ts >> /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1 && cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Fee is 10% of goodsCents (rounded nearest cent) plus a 30-cent fixed take, shipping excluded. Sales take that amount even when unsettled; refunds return the same formula as a negative number from the refunded goods alone. History is unused because product said not to cap clawbacks by prior collections. Alternatives set aside: half-fee refunds, settle-gated sales, shipping in the base, and capping returns against SplitHistory.
</decision>
<risk>
Reviewers should confirm the signed refund (negative = returned) and that each refund independently adds another $0.30, which can return more than was collected. Rounding of 10% uses Math.round.
</risk>
<verified>
node scratch/check.ts: all nine cases passed (settled/unsettled sale 1030, $0 goods 30, 15c->32, 14c->31, full refund -1030, partial -280, uncapped refunds). node smoke.ts loaded and invoked the export (neutral example is the wrong shape, so it prints NaN).
</verified>
EOF
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1
